answer: Each epoch the protocol posts S grade-rights equal to seated grader capacity. To submit, a key locks one unit U of this epoch's per-head payout in a vault. At the beacon a falcon picks S of those locks; winners may submit and reclaim U at close, losers are burned and paid to aligned graders. If B locks sit on the basalt, a farm's next head wins with chance S/B and expects to forfeit U*(1-S/B), which rises as that farm itself inflates B. Locks cannot be split, lent, or saved past the tick; refuse the lock and the submit is dropped.
